'''Taim & Bak''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporation that manufactured ranged weapons in the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], [[Laser/Legends|laser]], and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] range of products.

==History==
Founded prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Taim & Bak's dedication to weapons development saw their systems used across a variety of applications, from small [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to mammoth [[Capital ship/Legends|capital-class]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. Named for the two families who founded and owned it, the [[Taim family|Taim]] and [[Bak family|Bak]] families shared research and development facilities with [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel Galactic Defense]] to save on costs.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref><ref name="NEGWT" />

Their designs were used by vehicle and starship manufacturers on both sides of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], particularly their [[KX-4 laser cannon turret|KX line]] of starfighter-scale laser cannons and [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX line]] of heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].
